items.title: Spotify desktop - 'Electro' playlist with four tracks
items.description: A desktop Spotify view: 'Electro - Spotify playlist · 4 tracks' cover grid, Play button, and a track table (Alibazone, Gris Gang, 'If you wanna party, come over to my house' - Flobeks highlighted, Drop Dead Gorgeous - Princess Nokia) with a playing bar below. A playlist teardown, not a mail app.

items.title: Milestone payment - €5,000.00 with card/bank/crypto methods
items.description: 'Complete your payment - from Abdi Samuel': €5,000.00 'Website design - Final milestone Phase 1', Your details (Full name, Email), Payment method chips (Card active, Bank transfer, Crypto), Card Number/MM-YY/CVV and a black 'Pay €5,000.00' button. An invoice checkout.

items.title: Fintech board - $3.20M dot ring over Hook/Growth gap/Loss cards
items.description: A light analytics frame: a ring of black/white dots around '$3.20M', below it grey cards 'Hook', 'Growth gap' and a peach 'Loss' card on a tick ruler. A funnel/retention board, not a tabs home.

items.title: Flora Brush - a living brush that grows ferns and flowers
items.description: 'Flora Brush - A living brush': botanical strokes (ferns, blossoms, butterflies) forming letters on white, with Brush size/Undo/Clear controls on a green field. A generative nature-drawing tool, not a garden planner.

items.title: Café chat - colour-highlighted message lines over white
items.description: A chat over a sunset photo edge: stacked highlight bubbles ('Perfect. I'll bring your book back too.', 'That's it. I heard their breakfast', 'The little one with... is really good.', 'Yes - the green door?', 'please. Let's try the new café by the park.', 'Coffee tomorrow? I'm free around ten.') with a Message bar. Same thread as VID-0294.

items.title: Clockwork sticker pack - holographic landmark stickers
items.description: A dark phone: holographic stickers (pyramid, Sydney Opera House, Christ the Redeemer) above a 'Clockwork - 5 stickers' tray. A sticker-pack moment.

items.title: Longterm health - radial overview ring with excellent score
items.description: A health onboarding: 'Overview 1 Excellent / Health Age Get Started' chips above a colourful segmented ring, then 'Get An Overview of Your Longterm Health - Health can analyze the data from your phone, watch and advanced new assessments...'. A radial health intro.

items.title: Dashr - lime splash and 'Deliver faster, earn smarter'
items.description: A lime 'Dashr' splash beside the onboarding card 'Deliver faster, earn smarter with Dashr' with rider illustrations, 'Get on the Road' and 'Already a Dashr rider? Log in'. The same product as IMG-0494.

items.title: 'Pick your vibe' - twelve illustrated faces, one ticked
items.description: A grey sheet under a 'VB' avatar: 'Pick your vibe' with a 3x4 grid of line-drawn faces (one green-ticked). An avatar/vibe picker.

items.title: Introductions - avatar circle and nickname on cream
items.description: A cream onboarding: 'First of all, introductions - Tell us a bit about yourself...' with an illustrated avatar ringed by tiny faces, a 'Nickname - Choose a nickname' field and black Continue. A profile-setup step.

items.title: Grace journal - 'Hangout at our place!' and a July entry
items.description: A cream personal journal for 'Grace': a 'Hangout at our place! in 5 days' card with a coffee icon, then a July entry 'Saw her and Jon for coffee when I dropped off her gift! They met my brother. Jul 15'. A memory journal, not a magazine.

items.title: In-hand camera - f/2.8 400 60 exposure pill over a red set
items.description: A hand holds a phone whose camera view shows a red backdrop and gear, with a yellow film-style pill reading f/2.8 · 400 · 60 (aperture/ISO/shutter) and a white shutter dot. A manual-camera moment.

items.title: Afterglow - a pink film/TV story journal with Severance detail
items.description: A foldable pink app 'Afterglow - For the love of a good story.': left 'Stay for the story' (Dune: Part Two) with All titles/Films/Series and a list (Severance, Past Lives); right 'The big picture' for Severance (9.4 TMDB, The story, The people behind it). A watchlist journal, not a social profile.

items.title: App teardown - 'Rock Identifier: Stone ID' metrics and video
items.description: An app-store teardown page: 'Rock Identifier: Stone ID - Next Vision Limited, 4.7, 80K reviews, Education' with $800k MRR, 200k downloads/mo, 11 screens, 1:37 length, captured 12 September 2026, store screenshots and a playing video of 'Your Personal Geology Tutor' bubble chart. An analytics teardown, not a stats dashboard.

items.title: Meetball - 'Share transcript' sheet with app destinations
items.description: A white 'Share transcript' modal: a pinned note ('Opening copy needs a decision before Wednesday...'), 'Add to' icons (Drive, Notion, Linear, Jira, Slack), meetball.app link with Copy link, under a blue 'Ask Meetball' pill. A meeting-notes share sheet.

items.title: Piggy finance - rent due Sun 23 with transactions below
items.description: A pig-mascot finance screen ('Piggy Need Money'): 'Upcoming' card (Sun 23 August 2026, Home Rent 120.23$) and 'Transactions' (25.00$ Receive, Agu 23). A playful budget app, not iOS widgets.

items.title: Correspondence envelopes - LUCÍA and MIRA letter folders
items.description: Two paper letter folders on a board: cream 'LUCÍA - Correspondencia · Español, SEVILLA 12 SEPT' and teal 'MIRA - Correspondencia · Français'. A tactile correspondence/pen-pal visual.

items.title: Dark sticker chat - blue summary banner and AI actions
items.description: A dark thread under a blue banner ('scheduled 5 1 meeting.', 3 hours ago, 12/14/2 counts) with floating stickers (chair, portrait, tongue, dice), 'Change background to gradient' and an Ask row - a sticker chat with AI actions.

items.title: Event setup - friends count, scattered genre chips, time
items.description: A dark setup sheet: 'Friends attend 12', 'Genres Afrobeat, Bluegrass +6' with scattered selectable genre chips (Disco, Electronic, Folk, Funk, Hip-Hop, House...), 'Time 7:00 pm', Reset all and blue 'Continue with 4'. An event-preferences picker.

items.title: Voice recorder - 00:01 waveform with stop/record/delete
items.description: A dark recorder card: waveform at 00:01 'New Audio from you', round stop/play-record/delete buttons, above a list of received voice messages (01:09, 00:36). A voice-memo moment.

items.title: Scrapbook journal - pool-day page with stickers and tape
items.description: A journal page 'Aug 3, Mon': 'A scorching summer day at Jamwon Hangang Pool with the kids.' with a duck sticker, kids' photos, washi tape and an edit toolbar (undo, Aa, stickers). A scrapbook entry, not a feed card.

items.title: Spending breakdown - $1,240 with a capsule bar and categories
items.description: A dark 'Spending $1,240 spent' screen: Week/Month/Year tabs, a rainbow capsule bar, and a two-column category list (Housing $700 28%, Groceries $450 17%, Shopping $350 14%... Subscriptions $40 2%) with a Home/Spending/Setting dock and FAB. A spend analytics screen, not an expense entry.

items.title: Apps board - rankings cards and a watching list
items.description: A dark 'Apps' screen: cards (Toplify: App Rankings, Subscription Day. Calendar - Chuta Dmytro) and a Watching list (zerotake, Open Pi - Raspberry Pi Manager, Plastic: Vinyl CD collection, Prostir zvuku) with a + button. An app-discovery board.

items.title: Café chat over a river photo - highlights and a Space hint
items.description: A chat floating over a river-and-cliff photo: teal/yellow highlight bubbles repeating the café thread ('Perfect. I'll bring your book back too.' ... 'Coffee tomorrow? I'm free around ten.') with a black 'Space' key hint. Same thread as VID-0256 in context.
